items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Carver was with Earl Hines but I didn’t hear him very much, maybe on Skylark or something, just little fills here and there.

ctx.x: Gee you’re one of the first jazz flute players. Where did you — did you hear anybody else doing it before you? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
Yes I did. The first one I think was Waymon Carter. Is that his name? Carver.
